register.description: uDMA source address for secured read master. Must be Word aligned.

bitfield.description: DMA SEC JOB SRC ADDR: Specifies source address for secured read master. Source address must comply with bit.26 to enable Sec/Non-Sec accesses, otherwise transactions will be blocked.

register.description: uDMA destination address for secured write master. Must be Word aligned.

bitfield.description: DMA SEC JOB DST ADDR: Specifies destination address for secured write master. Destination address must comply with bit.26 to enable Sec/Non-Sec accesses, otherwise transactions will be blocked.
DMA SEC JOB LENGTH: Resolution - 1 Word Maximum configurable job size - 1 Mega byte (256K Words). (Maximum available size in MEMSS is 1MB).
DMA SEC JOB MODE: 0 - Data movement from External memory to Internal memory. 1 - Data movement from Internal memory to External memory.
DMA SEC JOB START WRCL: Start command for uDMA to start working on secured configured job.
DMA SEC JOB CLEAR WRCL: Clear command for uDMA to stop working and clear configuration.

DMA SEC JOB ACTIVE: Status bit to indicate that DMA is processing a secured job. When this bit is set, SW has written all the job parameters and also provided a start_pulse to HW, and cannot change job parameters without clear_pulse. Job will wait to be executed (indicated by job_in_progress)
DMA SEC JOB IN PROGRESS: 1- sec job is currently in progress and being executed by uDMA
DMA SEC JOB IRQ WORDS LEFT: number of words left in sec job when IRQ error raised and IRQ rdcl status value is not 2'd3

Status vector for IRQ indication for secured DMA IRQ: 2'd0 - DMA done. 2'd1 - DMA bus error occurred. check SEC_STATUS in order to recovers 2'd2 - DMA security error occurred. *** (==1'b0) - No DMA security error can occur in Security Channel ***

register.description: uDMA source address for non-secured read master. Must be Word aligned.

bitfield.description: DMA NONSEC JOB SRC ADDR: Specifies source address for non-secured read master. Source address must comply with bit.26 to enable Sec/Non-Sec accesses, otherwise transactions will be blocked. In case using SAU to define secured memory region 'inside' the non-secured, this channel will allow this.

register.description: uDMA destination address for non-secured write master. Must be Word aligned.

bitfield.description: DMA NONSEC JOB DST ADDR: Specifies destination address for non-secured write master. Destination address must comply with bit.26 to enable Sec/Non-Sec accesses, otherwise transactions will be blocked. In case using SAU to define secured memory region 'inside' the non-secured, this channel will allow this.
DMA NONSEC JOB LENGTH: Resolution - 1 Word Maximum configurable job size - 1 Mega byte (256K Words). (Maximum available size in MEMSS is 1MB).
DMA NONSEC JOB MODE: 0 - Data movement from External memory to Internal memory. 1 - Data movement from Internal memory to External memory.
DMA NONSEC JOB START WRCL: Start command for uDMA to start working on non-secured configured job.
DMA NONSEC JOB CLEAR WRCL: Clear command for uDMA to stop working and clear configuration.

DMA NONSEC JOB ACTIVE: Status bit to indicate that DMA is processing a non-secured job. When this bit is set, SW has written all the job parameters and also provided a start_pulse to HW, and cannot change job parameters without clear_pulse. Job will wait to be executed (indicated by job_in_progress)
DMA NONSEC JOB IN PROGRESS: 1- nonsec job is currently in progress and being executed by uDMA
DMA NONSEC JOB IRQ WORDS LEFT: number of words left in nonsec job when IRQ error raised and IRQ rdcl status value is not 2'd3
Status vector for IRQ indication for non-secured DMA IRQ: 2'd0 - DMA done. 2'd1 - DMA bus error occurred. check NONSEC_STATUS in order to recovers 2'd2 - DMA security error occurred.
